messages:
paul_mktg: Quick kickoff: Micro-Ref Launch pack -> one-file refapp, 12m tutorial vid, short benchmark blurb, 45m community stream. Target publish Tue 11:00 PT. Need leads for repo, tutorial, bench, landing, ops.

rina_devrel: I can own refapp + tutorial. Idea: tiny chat+search demo showing embeddings + streaming tokens. Keep repo single python file and <180 LOC.

otto_eng: Ill run microbenches. Two modes: interactive (<=512 tokens) and long-context (>=4096). Will output p50/p95 + cost/1k tokens. Need ~250 seed prompts from Rina.

leah_growth: Landing + signup owner. Map signups to HubSpot list "Micro-Ref Launch" -> SFDC mapping. CTA options: [Run Live] + [Register]. Will schedule email + X thread. Use utm_campaign=micro_ref_launch.

sam_ops: Ill prepare webinar ops runbook: monitoring hooks, fallback model variant, and rollback play. Ops checklist: test run @30min before, GPU watch, recording check.

content-bot: Calendar slot reserved Tue 11:00. Staging preview: https://micro-ref-preview.redwood.dev (internal). Drafts due Mon EOD.

rina_devrel: Repo scaffold pushed: `micro_ref.py` w/ README. Hero try-it curl for README: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"open-micro\",\"prompt\":\"Summarize...\"}'`

otto_eng: First bench numbers in sheet: interactive p50=48ms p95=210ms; long p50=230ms p95=720ms. Exported CSV of prompts+responses to shared drive. Will draft a 3-paragraph benchmark blurb focusing on dev tradeoffs.

leah_growth: Landing copy v1 in Figma. Two CTAs implemented; wiring HubSpot webhook -> Zapier fallback -> SFDC. Hidden field `source=micro_ref_launch`. Promo cadence: email Tue AM, X thread Tue noon, Dev Forum Wed.

sam_ops: Added ops notes to repo: recommended runtime flags `batch_size=8`, `kv_cache=true`, `quant=4bit`. Added GPU alert thresholds and fallback to smaller model variant.

paul_mktg: Owners confirmed: repo+tuto Rina; bench Otto + Paul; landing+email Leah; ops Sam; promo assets Leah+Rina. Publish Tue 11:00 PT, social blast Tue 12:00 PT.

paul_mktg: Final ask: drop preview links, recording notes, and any screenshots in this thread by Mon EOD. Call out blockers now. :rocket:
